note: Snapshot of the real production SmsTemplate rows (from the Fleebee dashboard, 2026-07-23). Used by speak_templates.py when the local database has no templates. Re-export when the operator edits templates.

templates.title: Notary step
templates.body: {{firstName}}, nyuma yo gufata moto yawe tuzahurira kwa notaire kugira ngo dusoze amasezerano. Niba umwishingizi wawe agomba kuza gusinya, mutegure neza.

templates.title: Authorization Completed
templates.body: {{firstName}}, uruhushya (RURA) rwa moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} rwabonetse. Waza kunyura kwa Notaire kurufata - Kicukiro.

templates.title: Authorization in progress
templates.body: {{firstName}}, ubusabe bw'uruhushya rwa moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} buri gukurikiranwa kuri RURA. Turacyabikurikirana.

templates.title: Authorization pending
templates.body: {{firstName}}, uruhushya rwa moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} ruracyategerejwe kuri RURA. Icyakora dosiye yawe iri gukurikiranwa kandi tuzakumenyesha uko bimeze.

templates.title: Batch notice
templates.body: {{firstName}}, iri tangazo rireba batch yawe {{batchName}}. Nyamuneka kurikiza amabwiriza watangiwe kandi ukomeze gukurikirana andi makuru.

templates.title: Cleanliness reminder
templates.body: {{firstName}}, twibutse ko isuku ya moto yawe {{plate}} n'imyitwarire myiza bifasha akazi kawe no kurinda ibihombo.

templates.title: Emergency notice
templates.body: {{firstName}}, hari ikibazo cyihutirwa kireba moto yawe {{plate}}. Nyamuneka twandikire cyangwa uduhamagare vuba bishoboka.

templates.title: Safety reminder
templates.body: {{firstName}}, turakwibutsa gutwara neza, kubahiriza amategeko y'umuhanda no kwita kuri moto yawe {{plate}} buri munsi.

templates.title: Service information
templates.body: {{firstName}}, igihe cya service cyangwa igenzura rya moto yawe {{plate}} nikigera uzabimenyeshwa. Komeza gukurikirana amakuru tuzakohereza.

templates.title: Delivery welcome
templates.body: {{firstName}}, turagushimiye. Wamaze guhabwa moto yawe {{plate}}. Komeza kuyitwaraho neza kandi tuzakomeza kukugezaho amakuru y'impapuro n'ubwishyu bukurikira.

templates.title: Traffic fine
templates.body: {{firstName}}, moto yawe {{plate}} yaciwe amande ya {{fineAmount}} kubera {{fineReason}}. Turagusaba kuyishyura ku gihe no kwirinda ko byongera kuba.

templates.title: Insurance in progress
templates.body: {{firstName}}, ubwishingizi bwa moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} buri gukorwa. Tuzakubwira umunsi wo kujya gufata moto vuba nitubona amakuru mashya.

templates.title: Lead captured
templates.body: {{firstName}}, twakiriye amakuru yawe kandi turi gutegura gahunda nshya ya moto. Tuzakomeza kukugezaho aho bigeze vuba.

templates.title: Payment reminder
templates.body: {{firstName}}, iyi ni reminder y'ubwishyu bukurikira bwa moto yawe {{plate}}. Itariki y'ubwishyu ni {{nextPaymentDate}}. Turakwinginze kubutegura ku gihe.

templates.title: Pickup scheduled
templates.body: {{firstName}}, witegure kuza gufata moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} ku itariki n'isaha twaguhaye. Ntuzibagirwe uruhushya rwo gutwara moto.

templates.title: Plate assigned
templates.body: {{firstName}}, moto yawe ifite plaque {{plate}} ubu yamaze kuboneka. Igikurikiraho ni ugukomeza gahunda y'ubwishingizi.

templates.title: Preparation notice
templates.body: {{firstName}}, tangira gutegura ibyangombwa byawe no gushaka umwishingizi uzakorana nawe. Turateganya ko uzabona amakuru mashya vuba.
